why: All three checks pass, so the finding stands. (1) QUOTE — verbatim at slash-commands.md:212, under the heading '### `/clear` - Reset conversation context'. The rest of that two-sentence line does not reverse it ('The previous conversation remains on disk and can be returned to by passing its session ID to the resume option'), and the page's other qualifiers do not rescue us: :214's 'no practical effect' caveat is scoped to one-shot query() calls that start with EMPTY context, whereas every ClaudeAgent turn passes `resume: this.sessionId` (claude-agent.ts:1607) so context is non-empty; and :217's version gate ('/clear in the SDK requires Claude Code v2.1.117 or later') is satisfied — the bundled binary reports '2.1.183 (Claude Code)' (node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64/claude --version, SDK 0.3.183). (2) STATE — the constant is exact, at claude-agent.ts:1665, not the cited :1643 (line drift only; :1643 is now `attemptedBranchCutoff`). It is the only definition of that identifier in the repo (grep -a; the only other hit is the built apps/electron/dist/main.cjs:404259), so no sibling-subsystem confusion. (3) CONSEQUENCE — verified separately and independently of the identifier, and nothing upstream or downstream handles /clear. Upstream: the composer menu ships a `clear` entry (slash-command-menu.tsx:162, asserted by slash-command-menu.test.tsx:29), composer capabilities expose it to every backend (`slash: { commandIds: 'all' }`, composer-capabilities.ts:103), and dispatchSlashCommandAction falls through all the UI-handler branches to MESSAGE_COMMANDS.clear = '/clear' (slash-command-actions.ts:57) and calls submitCommand, i.e. it is sent as an ORDINARY MESSAGE (FreeFormInput.tsx:1034 -> onSubmit). Mid-path: SessionManager.sendMessage's only command classifier is parseSessionCommand (SessionManager.ts:15095) and BaseAgent.chat's only one is the same function (base-agent.ts:2758); session-command.ts claims ONLY /compact and /subtask, so /clear takes the composed-context branch — which means by the time chatImpl sees it the pinned capability block is already prefixed and the `^\/([a-z]+)` match at :1670 cannot even fire. Downstream: buildTextPrompt (claude-agent.ts:2429-2468) pushes contextParts first and the user text last, so the model receives '/clear' as trailing prose. The one function that would implement it, clearSessionMessages (sessions/storage.ts:457, doc-comment 'Used for /clear command'), has NO production caller (only the index.ts re-export), and agent.clearHistory() likewise has no non-test caller. Not an owner decision: none of the nine dated decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md §3 touches slash commands (they are the seatbelt wildcard, availableModels/isManagedModelAllowed, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, and three SessionMirrorStore rows). Not a de-brand or dropped-subscription product difference either — the /clear menu entry is shipped and user-reachable. The parity report even marks `agent-sdk/slash-commands` as 'all built' (2026-07-30-parity-report.md:161). The nearest prior art is the parity audit's S15 note (2026-07-25-nessy-claude-parity-audit.md, ~:527): '/clear and /help are dead the same way and deliberately NOT classifier-claimed until implemented' — an explicitly OPEN follow-up ('until implemented'), i.e. corroboration of this finding, not a decision to leave it.
correctedState: Confirmed with three corrections. (a) The cited line has drifted: the constant is `const SDK_SLASH_COMMANDS = ['compact'] as const;` at packages/shared/src/agent/claude-agent.ts:1665 (:1643 is now `attemptedBranchCutoff`). (b) /context and /usage do NOT fall through to buildTextPrompt — dispatchSlashCommandAction returns early for them and opens native UI (openContext / refreshUsage+openUsage, slash-command-actions.ts:104-129), so they never reach the agent at all; that is a legitimate local implementation, not a gap. The commands that really are submitted as message text are /clear and /help (MESSAGE_COMMANDS, :55-74). (c) The allowlist is not the only gate and not the whole story: the product-wide classifier `parseSessionCommand` (packages/shared/src/slash-commands/session-command.ts:45) claims only /compact and /subtask, and BaseAgent.chat (base-agent.ts:2758) prefixes the pinned capability block to everything else — so /clear is dead on the Pi backend too (pi-agent.ts:6477 uses the same classifier), not only under ClaudeAgent. Net user-visible state: the composer ships a 'Clear' command that, on every backend, reaches the model as trailing prose inside a context-wrapped prompt and clears nothing; clearSessionMessages (sessions/storage.ts:457) and agent.clearHistory() both exist with no production caller. Note for whoever fixes it: adding 'clear' to SDK_SLASH_COMMANDS alone would not work — it must first be claimed by parseSessionCommand so the bare command survives context composition — and because each turn is a one-shot query() with `resume`, the fix likely also needs the local sdkSessionId reset that clearSessionMessages already implements, per slash-commands.md:214.
